svg.title: 2 2r Circuit
svg.desc: Circuit: R-2R ladder digital-to-analog converter. A horizontal chain of resistors R connects n nodes; each node also connects through a 2R resistor up to a digital input a0, a1, ... a(n-1). The left end goes through 2R to ground and the right end is the analog output V_out, so each bit contributes half as much as the bit to its right. Marius-Juston 2026
